capabilities: render image grids from image-grid code blocks
set per-image max widths with pipe syntax
open images in a full-screen lightbox preview
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display multiple images together in a grid layout within notes.
summary: Renders collections of images in a responsive CSS grid layout via image-grid code blocks with configurable columns, gaps, and per-image widths.
